notes.title: Test the game out yourself! Feedback most welcome!
notes.content:
It is with great excitement that I invite you to dive into the depths of the ocean for some beta-testing!

I'm planning on running the beta test until December 6th! It's an open beta, but if the participation count goes higher than anticipated I may make it limited. 

As it is, the game lets you explore a small basin, populated by a sunken pirate ship, mindless laser-shooting whales, bottles filled with voices of the dead, and ancient stone fragments, waiting to be found and translated!

There’s still a lot in my mind and on paper that isn’t in the game yet. But I want to get what I have into your hands so I can get feedback, and if I wait until I have everything done, then it’s going to be harder to make changes. Please note that I intend to work out whatever problems you will encounter. I want the final game to be as great as possible!

[b][url=https://forms.gle/rY3osc12fkgKJGG1A]Please feel free to leave your feedback on this form![/url][/b] All questions are anonymous and optional!

It’s been a long journey, and there’s still ways to go. But the game is at a checkpoint, so to speak, and I hope you’re able to make time to check it out!

Thank you so much for your interest and help. I sincerely hope you enjoy this beta!

Matthew Wojtechko, developer of [i]Secret of Sardinia[/i]

[h1]CONTROLS[/h1]
All you need to know to get started is how to swim and rotate. The final game will have a tutorial and let you customize controls. But for now, you can use either a game controller or keyboard with the following inputs:

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Action[/th]
        [th]Controller (Recommended)[/th]
        [th]Keyboard[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Swim[/td]
        [td]A[/td]
        [td]Enter[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Rotate[/td]
        [td]Primary Stick[/td]
        [td]WASD[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Camera[/td]
        [td]Left Shoulder[/td]
        [td]Left Shift[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Skitter[/td]
        [td]Right Shoulder[/td]
        [td]Space[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Swim Slowly[/td]
        [td]A twice[/td]
        [td]Enter twice[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Swim Backward[/td]
        [td]B[/td]
        [td]Right Shift[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Right as the fish becomes parallel with nearby ground, you can press the Swim button for a speed boost.

Turning the control stick faster makes the fish rotate faster. (This feature will soon be better integrated with keyboard controls.)
